linkedin.text:
I just found something that could save SEO professionals thousands per year.

I've been paying for Semrush. You probably have too. Or Ahrefs. Maybe both. Hundreds of dollars every single month for features you use maybe 10% of the time.

OpenSEO flips that model completely. It's open source, you self-host it (for free), and you only pay for what you actually use through DataForSEO's API.

The numbers are wild:
→ Track 100 keywords monthly: ~$1.20
→ 100 keyword research queries: ~$3.50
→ Full competitor backlink analysis: ~$10

Compare that to your current subscription.

It's not just about cost though. It has everything you actually need: keyword research, rank tracking, backlinks, competitor analysis, site audits. Clean UI. No bloat.

The part that really got me: it works with Claude through MCP. Your AI agent can now do keyword research and competitive analysis automatically.

Almost 4,000 developers have already starred it. Deploy on Cloudflare's free tier in about 10 minutes.

If you're spending hundreds monthly on SEO tools, this is worth looking at. Link in comments.
